raw_definitions: Definisi : b. ( conversation, meeting, etc ) tamat, selesai: the discussion ~ed out after an hour, perbincangan itu selesai selepas satu jam; c. diminish in amount, /beransur, semakin/ habis: the supplies ~ed out, and the soldiers had to live off the land, bekalan beransur habis, jadi askar itu terpaksa makan apa saja yg ada di hutan itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : vi ; ~ out, become gradually smaller, weaker, etc and then cease or disappear, a. ( of road, track, interest, voice, etc ), /beransur, semakin/ hilang: his enthusiasm ~ed out after a week, selepas satu minggu, semangatnya semakin hilang; the stream ~s out in the sandy soil, anak sungai itu beransur hilang di tanah yg berpasir; her voice ~ed out as terror overcame her, suaranya beransur hilang apabila dikuasai rasa takut yg amat sangat; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
